name: healthmanager
description: healthManager — NestJS API + React SPA, deployed as one Railway service

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend --include=dev && npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.api:sync: npm run export:openapi --prefix backend && npm run generate-client --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix shared && npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix shared && npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
